project_info.theme: Quán Nhậu Tự Do branch promo at 08 Lê Đại Hành

main_subject.detail: Vertical restaurant promo poster combining a nighttime photo of the Quán Nhậu Tự Do venue with a foreground collage of beer glasses and featured dishes around a central tabletop hotpot burner.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic venue-and-food composite, editorial restaurant promotion, cutout collage food styling

composition_elements.text: CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO – MỞ VỊ MỚI TẠI 08 LÊ ĐẠI HÀNH!!!
items: Top Left: Red and black headline 'CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO – MỞ VỊ MỚI TẠI 08 LÊ ĐẠI HÀNH!!!' on a white background.
Top Right: Large rounded-corner nighttime venue photo with glowing signage and the Quán Nhậu Tự Do logo inside the image.
Bottom Left: Two cutout beer glasses and multiple plated dishes with white sticker-style outlines.
Bottom Right: Additional cutout dishes including sliced meat and vegetable platter arranged around a green tabletop.
Center/Background: Central tabletop hotpot on a portable burner, layered in front of the venue photo and surrounded by dish cutouts.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Mixed night venue and food lighting
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm festive venue glow, crisp cutout shadows, bright food contrast, lively nightlife ambiance

Background is a clean white header area above a deep green tabletop base. Surrounding elements: exact red/black headline 'CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO – MỞ VỊ MỚI TẠI 08 LÊ ĐẠI HÀNH!!!', venue photo with glowing signage, two beer glasses at lower left, and multiple cutout dishes arranged around the hotpot. Technical style: photorealistic composite advertising poster, mixed night venue and food lighting, warm festive glow with crisp cutout shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
